verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a government digital-administration portal, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only shows a JavaScript shell behind an account and a Cloudflare-challenged ministry site. Nothing documents third-party authorization forms, delegate roles, or which signatures must stay personal.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
